Tessa (AE): FinServCo wants a short POC to prove real-time transaction normalization: streaming input -> function call normalization -> deterministic JSON output. Main asks: sub-200ms p95 latency, strict schema, and VPC-only deployment.
Ravi (PreSales): Got it. What languages do they want? Node ingestion, Go for downstream services.
Evan (Client - FinServCo): Correct. Also need a clear rollback if model returns invalid JSON. We can't accept malformed records.
Li (Engineer): Suggestion: use streaming API for low latency, but use function-calling with a parameter schema for the normalized fields. Function payloads are emitted as a single structured object which is easiest to validate server-side.
Ravi (PreSales): Agreed. For Node example we can demo streaming deltas then capture the function_call event, parse args, validate with AJV against their JSON Schema, and ack to their topic.
Li (Engineer): Example snippet (Node-ish):
```js
const s = client.responses.stream({ input });
s.on('delta', (d) => /* show progress */ );
s.on('function_call', (fc) => {
  const args = JSON.parse(fc.arguments);
  if (validate(args)) publish(args);
  else fallbackNormalize(args);
});
```
Nora (Security): VPC-only: Hosted API won't fly. We need to offer Dedicated or Private. Private gives full control over network and KMS; Dedicated could be acceptable if they accept managed infra and committed capacity. Also: retention policy must be set to zero for PII flows.
Tessa (AE): Evan, would Dedicated be acceptable or do you require private VPC?
Evan (Client - FinServCo): Private VPC is preferred by our infra team.
Ravi (PreSales): Ok mark Private as required. We'll prepare a Private deployment SOW and an alternative note for Dedicated in case they reconsider.
Evan (Client - FinServCo): Also, what about pricing for streaming? Do we pay per-connection or per-token?
Li (Engineer): Billing is token-based for generation. Streaming is a delivery mode; costs are tokens consumed. If concurrency grows, we may need reserved capacity which is contract-based (Dedicated).
Ravi (PreSales): I'll write a short pricing appendix showing per-token estimate for the demo hours and an example Dedicated commit scenario.
Nora (Security): I'll fill out the security questionnaire and a network diagram for Private deployment. Need answers from them on allowed egress endpoints and KMS ARN.
ci-bot: CI note: POC repo scaffolded at https://github.com/redwoodinc/poc-realtime-normalize (private).
Li (Engineer): For guaranteed output demo, plan a two-stage pipeline: 1) Stream + function call; 2) Schema validator; 3) If validation fails, run deterministic rule-based normalizer (or fallback small LLM with stricter prompting) and revalidate. We'll show metrics for success rate.
Evan (Client - FinServCo): Good. Can you include sample JSON with transaction_id, amount_usd_cents, merchant_uuid, category_code, timestamp_iso?
Li (Engineer): We'll include a sample and the AJV schema in the repo.
Tessa (AE): Scheduling: they want a 30-min tech demo Wednesday 10:00 ET. They also require an NDA before any data is shared.
Ravi (PreSales): I can run the demo. Li will do the integration deep dive. Nora will cover security Qs last 10 minutes.
Nora (Security): I'll prepare two versions of the security pack: Private deployment (network diagrams, KMS, retention=0) and Hosted notes (what we remove from logs). Expect drafts in 48 hours.
Evan (Client - FinServCo): NDA incoming. Also will send sample transactions (synthetic) for the POC.
Tessa (AE): Action items: 1) Tessa send NDA (today). 2) Ravi prepare pricing appendix + demo script (Mon). 3) Li push POC branch with Node + Go client examples and schema (Tue AM). 4) Nora complete security docs (Tue AM). 5) Prep calendar and invite after NDA signed.
Li (Engineer): I'll add a small test harness that injects synthetic stream events and measures p95 latency. We'll show graphs during demo.
Ravi (PreSales): Also add a short slide on fallback options and SLOs if Private infra can't meet p95 in initial sizing.
Evan (Client - FinServCo): Sounds good. NDA sent. Looking forward to the demo. :thumbsup:
Tessa (AE): Thanks everyone. Ravi, Li, Nora: please confirm when your items are done and I'll lock the calendar.
Ravi (PreSales): Confirmed — will update here when PR is ready.
Li (Engineer): PR created: https://github.com/redwoodinc/poc-realtime-normalize/pull/2
Nora (Security): Security pack uploaded to the repo (private) and shared with Evan's security alias.
Tessa (AE): Closing thread for coordination; follow-ups can be in the demo invite thread.
